Commercial Services

One contractor for the mechanical systems a Midlands business depends on.

When cooling fails in a restaurant dining room or a water line breaks over an office ceiling, the cost is not limited to the repair. It is revenue lost for every hour the building cannot operate normally. 2nd Wind Heating & Air Conditioning provides commercial HVAC, plumbing, drain, and generator services in Columbia, SC, so Midlands businesses have one accountable team for the systems that keep their doors open.

We serve offices, retail, and mixed-use buildings across the Midlands, along with restaurants and commercial kitchens where equipment uptime decides the day’s revenue, medical and dental facilities where air quality and reliable plumbing protect patients, and warehouse and distribution space where heating and ventilation cover large volumes. Server rooms and other spaces with tight temperature tolerances get equipment selected for continuous, precise operation.

Businesses that also need residential-style scope can find details under our cooling, heating, plumbing, and home generator pages.

Commercial Repair and Diagnostics

Our technicians service rooftop units, split systems, and packaged equipment, along with commercial plumbing, drain lines, and standby generators. The diagnostic process is the same one we use in homes: identify the failing component, record video of the finding, and present the repair options with prices before work begins. For a business owner or property manager who is not on site, that video is the difference between approving a repair blind and approving it with evidence.

Commercial Installation and Replacement

Whether you are upfitting a new space, replacing rooftop units at the end of their service life, or adding backup power, we size commercial systems to the building and its actual use. Load, ventilation requirements, and equipment placement are calculated rather than copied from whatever was there before, because an undersized system runs constantly and an oversized one cycles itself to an early failure. Coordinating HVAC, plumbing, and generator work through one contractor also means fewer trades to schedule and one team accountable for the result.

Commercial Maintenance Programs

Downtime costs more than maintenance. Our commercial maintenance programs put HVAC, plumbing, drains, and generators on a scheduled rhythm of inspections, cleanings, and small corrections: filters changed, coils cleaned, drain lines cleared, generators exercised under load, and documentation you can produce for an owner, a landlord, or an inspector. In Columbia’s climate, where cooling runs from spring into fall, coil cleaning alone pays for itself in reduced run time.
